name: prompt-kit
description: Model and placement routing (model-recommender), prompt authoring (smart-prompt), adversarial prompt review (prompt-audit), and escalation-tier tailoring plus handoff briefs (tailor-to-fable), driven by a shared, self-refreshing ~/.claude/model-profiles.md so routing never drifts between them or from loop-compiler. Routes by task shape and observed execution signals rather than a static model ranking, and distinguishes a session's model string from a subagent's model alias.
